movements.name: Baroque (late)
movements.style: chiaroscuro: one raking light in darkness, deep red damask, black-gold frames

movements.name: Rococo
movements.style: pastel blue-white boiserie, gilt C-scroll rocaille, mirror panels, silver

movements.name: Neoclassicism
notes: Likely: begun 1768/1769, rebuilt 1796-1809; 1772 is a mid-build date
movements.style: white marble, fluted Doric columns, coffered ceiling, cool even light

movements.name: Romanticism
notes: Confirmed: shown at the Salon of 1819
movements.style: Gothic Revival pointed vaults, storm-blue dusk, amber lamplight

movements.name: Realism
notes: Confirmed: lost in the Dresden bombing, February 1945
Likely: Haussmann's works 1853-1870; the link to Realism is the source's framing
movements.style: brick, plain plaster, iron trusses, north-light skylight

movements.name: Impressionism
notes: Likely: dated 1872, shown 1874; the single-morning claim is Suspected
movements.style: open pavilion, white walls, full daylight, glass roof

movements.name: Post-Impressionism
movements.style: saturated complementary walls (ultramarine and chrome yellow), hard sunlight

movements.name: Symbolism / Decadent
movements.style: black-violet velvet, gold leaf mosaic, candle glow

movements.name: Art Nouveau / Jugendstil
notes: Guimard Paris Metro entrances 1900 (cast in days)
